sourceLabel: Steward-curated planning map; public repository identities and linked sources checked 2026-10-20
mission: Help humans connect and regain, maintain, sustain, or enhance their agency.

projects.name: DecentAgency
projects.purpose: The steward-described umbrella for these Decent Frankensteins, not a claim of legal ownership or GitHub organization membership.
projects.nextAction: Use Canopy and Busking as the current delivery focus; adapt their work to BigNuten next, then review the rest of the inventory.

projects.name: DecentCanopy
projects.purpose: Make projects, repositories, creators, funding relationships, and useful next steps understandable.
projects.currentState: Existing constellation, creator sidepanels, wallet-signed creator records, site/data IPFS publication, and community pinning rewards. GitHub identity linking and generic fund adapters remain open work.
projects.nextAction: Use this curated map to guide optional public GitHub linking (#11), the shared evidence schema (#17), and Busking fund/ledger discovery (#14).

projects.name: DecentBusking
projects.purpose: Support music participation, scheduled radio, and accountable creator and contributor earnings.
projects.currentState: The steward reports the first week's schedule and payroll completed. Public code documents media uploads, recoverable IPFS checkpoints, fund indexing, and payment ledgers. This map has not reconciled week-one payout receipts.
projects.nextAction: Review week-one outcomes and receipts, resolve the reported browser playback problem (#244), and define the next schedule/payroll slice against existing performance and playlist issues.

projects.name: BigNuten_Vanilla
projects.purpose: Support body-care and wellness participation in the dapp's own reward and user-owned data context.
projects.currentState: The steward reports an IPFS stall motivated the wider storage work. BigNuten already has an open Busking-adaptation epic; its README documents personal IPFS storage and bounty operations. The current stall has not been reproduced by this map.
projects.nextAction: Reproduce the stalled save/restore path, then adapt scoped uploads (#339) and snapshot recovery (#341), coordinating with the existing storage issues instead of copying Busking wholesale.
